name: hackupc-planstack-spike
description: Phased plans, sidebar orchestration, separate planning (Chat) and execution (Run phase) settings.

commands.title: Planstack: Re-sync plan to current codebase
Planstack: Merge completed plan branch into base branch

planstack.executor.activeProfile.markdownDescription: Headless CLI used for **Chat → Create plan**, **Send**, and **Run phase** when `planstack.cursor.executionMode` is **`cli`**. Also mirrored in the Planstack Chat panel. Junie CLI is [EAP](https://junie.jetbrains.com/docs/junie-headless.html).
enumDescriptions: JetBrains Junie CLI (`junie --auth … --project …`). Requires token from junie.jetbrains.com/cli.

planstack.executor.juniePath.description: Executable for Junie CLI (PATH name or absolute path). Used when activeProfile is junie-cli.

planstack.executor.writeHandoffFile.description: When using native-first (clipboard) handoff, also write the prompt to the handoff file path for JetBrains Junie @-attach.

planstack.executor.writeHandoffFileOnCli.description: Before each Run phase (including headless CLI), write the phase prompt to the handoff file so the same repo opened in IntelliJ can load it in Junie.

planstack.executor.handoffFileRelativePa.description: Workspace-relative path for the markdown handoff file (POSIX slashes).

planstack.cursor.activeProfile.markdownDescription: **Legacy:** prefer `planstack.executor.activeProfile`. When non-empty and `planstack.executor.activeProfile` is default, this value is used.

planstack.cursor.planningMode.description: How Chat → Create plan produces structured plan JSON. "cli" uses the Cursor headless agent in read-only print mode. Additional values may be added later.

planstack.cursor.executionMode.markdownDescription: How **Run phase** runs (Overview or command palette). Default **`cli`** runs the Cursor agent in the workspace with `--force`. Leave **empty** to use legacy `planstack.cursor.handoff`. Set **`native-first`** for clipboard + optional Composer command instead.
enumDescriptions: Use legacy `planstack.cursor.handoff` when valid; otherwise cli.
Headless Cursor agent with --force in the workspace (may edit files); needs CURSOR_API_KEY and agent on PATH (see README).

planstack.cursor.handoff.markdownDescription: **Deprecated:** use `planstack.cursor.executionMode` for phase execution. Still read when `executionMode` is empty, for existing workspaces.

planstack.cursor.openComposerCommand.description: Optional VS Code command ID to open or focus Cursor Composer/Agent after the prompt is copied. Overrides legacy hackupc.nativeHandoff.openComposerCommand when set.

hackupc.nativeHandoff.openComposerComman.description: Legacy: same as planstack.cursor.openComposerCommand. Used when planstack.cursor.openComposerCommand is empty.

planstack.cursor.mongoDatabase.description: MongoDB database name for plan sync (Overview Push/Pull).

planstack.cursor.mongoCollection.description: MongoDB collection name for plan documents (each document: _id = plan id, payload, updatedAt, revision).

planstack.cursor.agentPath.description: Executable for the Cursor headless CLI (must be on PATH or an absolute path). Used for Chat → Create plan (planning) and CLI-based execution when wired.

planstack.cursor.agentTimeoutMs.description: Max wait for a single agent -p run (milliseconds). Applies to planning (Create plan) and CLI execution paths.

planstack.cursor.agentMaxStdoutChars.description: Max stdout characters captured from agent (safety cap). Applies to planning and CLI execution paths.

planstack.cursor.agentChatLiveStream.description: Show live agent stdout/stderr in the Planstack Chat panel (scrollable block). When false, use throttled system-line bubbles instead (cliStreamChatThrottleMs).

planstack.cursor.cliStreamAgentOutput.description: Stream live agent stdout/stderr to Output → Planstack during Create plan and Run phase (CLI).

planstack.cursor.revealAgentEditedFiles.markdownDescription: During **Run phase** / Chat **Send** when the Cursor `agent` CLI runs with `--force`, watch files under the run working directory and **open changed or created files** as preview tabs so you can follow edits live. Ignores `.git` and `node_modules`. Turn off if tab churn is distracting.

planstack.cursor.revealAgentEditedFilesF.description: When revealAgentEditedFiles is on: if true, move keyboard focus to each opened editor; if false (default), open preview tabs but keep focus where it was (e.g. Planstack Chat).

planstack.cursor.revealAgentEditedFilesD.description: Debounce (ms) before opening an editor after a file change event, coalescing rapid writes to the same path.

planstack.cursor.cliStreamProgressThrott.description: Minimum interval (ms) between Run phase notification progress updates driven by agent stderr.

planstack.cursor.cliStreamChatThrottleMs.description: Minimum interval (ms) between Chat system lines when mirroring agent output during CLI runs.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of @file mentions resolved per Chat message.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxFileByte.description: Maximum file size in bytes allowed for a single @file mention.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxTotalCha.description: Maximum combined characters injected from all @file mentions in one message.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxEntities.description: Maximum number of @phase / @task mentions resolved per Chat message.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxSymbols.description: Maximum number of @symbol mentions whose source body is attached per Chat message.

planstack.cursor.chatMentionsMaxSymbolCh.description: Maximum characters retained per @symbol mention body before truncation.

planstack.cursor.showGitSummaryAfterCliR.description: After a successful Run phase (CLI), append git diff --stat vs HEAD to Output and post a short summary to Chat.

planstack.cursor.cliRunGitSnapshotInterv.markdownDescription: While **Run phase (CLI)** is in progress, post distilled **`[git]`** lines to Planstack Chat on this interval (ms): first tick is a short **baseline** (status + head of diff --stat); later ticks post only **line deltas** vs the previous snapshot when it **changes**. **0** disables mid-run snapshots (post-run summary is unchanged).

planstack.cursor.cliRunAgentDigestInterv.markdownDescription: While **Run phase (CLI)** is in progress, post a **short tail** of accumulated agent stdout/stderr to Chat as system lines on this interval (ms). Only posts when the tail **changes**. **0** disables. Works alongside **agentChatLiveStream**.

planstack.cursor.useWsl.markdownDescription: **Windows only.** Spawn the Cursor agent inside WSL (`wsl.exe -d <wslDistro> --exec`) instead of native Windows. Useful when the agent CLI is installed inside WSL rather than on Windows. The workspace path is automatically converted to the WSL mount path (`C:\...` → `/mnt/c/...`). Set `planstack.cursor.agentPath` to the Linux binary name (e.g. `agent` or `cursor`) when this is enabled.

planstack.cursor.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution name to use when planstack.cursor.useWsl is enabled (e.g. "Ubuntu", "Ubuntu-22.04"). Run `wsl -l` in a terminal to list installed distributions.

planstack.requireTaskPrompt.markdownDescription: When **true**, **Run task** requires a non-empty `task.prompt` (handoff includes task-specific guidance). When **false**, the task title and phase/plan context are enough and the sidebar does not block the run button for an empty prompt.
